subtopic_title: Construction of parallel and perpendicular lines.

candidates.proposed_objective_text: Identify parallel and perpendicular lines in real-world contexts.
candidates.evidence_quote: What is the relationship between the bottom rail marked $AB$ and the balusters marked $AC$ and $BD$?
candidates.rationale: The Chapter 15 records assess identifying parallel and perpendicular line relationships in a real-world diagram. That is measurable, but it is not the same operation as constructing those lines with a straightedge and compasses.
